intro: Persian Cucumber is a refreshing topping on the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings) that adds crisp texture and light flavor to any bowl or pita. At just 15 calories and included in your meal at no extra charge, these thinly sliced seedless cucumbers provide a clean, hydrating element that complements CAVA's Mediterranean flavors perfectly.
priceCalories: Persian Cucumber is included with every [full CAVA menu](/menu/toppings) order at no additional cost, making it an excellent value addition. With only 15 calories per serving, 1g of carbs, and 1g of fat, this topping delivers refreshing crunch without impacting your nutritional goals, whether building a bowl or pita.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets Persian Cucumber apart is its seedless variety and delicate slicing. Unlike regular cucumbers, Persian cucumbers are naturally sweeter, thinner-skinned, and completely seedless. This premium cucumber variety provides consistent crunch and mild flavor that enhances without overpowering other ingredients on the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings).
nutritionFacts: Persian Cucumber delivers minimal macronutrients with 15 calories, 0g protein, 1g carbohydrates, and 1g fat per serving. The cucumber's high water content provides hydration while adding virtually no calories. This makes it an ideal topping choice when using the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to build lighter, vegetable-forward meals.
whatsInside: This topping contains only one simple ingredient: sliced seedless Persian cucumber. No additives, preservatives, or dressings are included. The cucumbers are freshly sliced to maintain their crisp texture and natural flavor. This clean ingredient list makes Persian Cucumber suitable for virtually any dietary preference on the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu).
tasteLike: Persian Cucumber offers a mild, slightly sweet flavor with crisp, refreshing texture. The taste is clean and neutral, providing a cooling contrast to spiced proteins and bold dressings. Each slice delivers satisfying crunch with subtle cucumber essence that does not compete with other flavors in your customized bowl or pita creation.
customize: Add Persian Cucumber to any base from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) for instant refreshment. Layer it with grains, greens, or pita for textural contrast. Combine with multiple toppings to create dimension in your bowl. The cucumbers work equally well in curated menu items or fully customized creations built to your preferences.
pairsWell: Persian Cucumber pairs exceptionally well with Tomato + Onion, Sumac Cabbage Slaw, and Shredded Romaine for a vegetable-packed meal. It complements spicy proteins and rich dips from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads). The cooling effect balances bold dressings, while the crunch contrasts beautifully with creamy hummus and soft grains.
healthyChoice: As a virtually calorie-free topping, Persian Cucumber is an excellent choice for health-conscious diners. The high water content supports hydration while the fiber aids digestion. With no added sodium or sugar, it is perfect for clean eating, low-calorie, and low-carb diets when building meals with the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator).
howToOrder: Select Persian Cucumber when customizing your bowl or pita in the toppings section. It is automatically included at no charge, so add generously to increase vegetable intake. Available at all [CAVA Locations](/locations), request it alongside other fresh toppings when building your meal at the counter or through online ordering platforms.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Tomato + Onion at 20 calories, Persian Cucumber offers lighter refreshment at just 15 calories. While Sumac Cabbage Slaw provides 30 calories with tangy flavor, cucumbers deliver neutral crunch. Shredded Romaine at 5 calories is lighter but lacks the satisfying texture that Persian Cucumber provides to complete your bowl.
whoShouldTry: Persian Cucumber is perfect for diners looking for crisp hydration, light crunch, and clean Mediterranean flavor to balance spicy chicken, lamb, or creamy dips.
worthTrying: Persian Cucumber is absolutely worth adding to your CAVA order. As a complimentary topping that enhances texture, adds freshness, and provides hydration with minimal calories, it delivers maximum value. The premium seedless variety and expert slicing make this simple ingredient a standout component that elevates any customized creation on the menu.

faqs.q: How many calories are in CAVA Persian Cucumber?
faqs.a: CAVA Persian Cucumber contains 15 calories per serving with 1g of carbs and 1g of fat. It is included free with all bowls and pitas.

faqs.q: Is Persian Cucumber at CAVA gluten-free?
faqs.a: Yes, Persian Cucumber is completely gluten-free as it contains only sliced seedless cucumbers with no additives, making it safe for celiac diets and appearing on the CAVA Gluten Free Menu.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Persian Cucumber and regular cucumber?
faqs.a: Persian cucumbers are smaller, sweeter, and completely seedless with thinner, more tender skin. CAVA uses this premium variety for superior taste and texture compared to standard cucumbers.

faqs.q: Does Persian Cucumber cost extra at CAVA?
faqs.a: No, Persian Cucumber is included with your meal at no additional charge. It is part of the complimentary toppings selection available when customizing any bowl or pita.

faqs.q: What does Persian Cucumber pair well with at CAVA?
faqs.a: Persian Cucumber pairs excellently with Tomato + Onion, Shredded Romaine, spicy proteins, creamy dips, and bold dressings. It adds refreshing crunch that balances rich and spicy flavors throughout your bowl.
